notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9940578/4501a6bb9346dda61112b5511f3f75b48df3c73e.png[/img]

Merry Christmas to all Wild Animal fans from Ginger the Giraffe, Hugo the hippo and all the Wild Animal crew.

Hope everyone's having a nice time and not too cold 🥶🥶⛄☃ (or hot... 🥵 depending on where you live.. 🦘)

Don't forget it is the Steam Winter Sale so you can find lots of bargains this winter. (Which is actually summer if you live in the Southern Hemisphere. Which is a "fun" fact.)  

Some of you may not know that there is more than one Wild Animal game:

[list]
[*] [b]Wild Animal Racing (where it all started...)[/b]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/389510/Wild_Animal_Racing

[list]
[*] [b]Wild Animal Sports Day[/b] (it continues...)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/741990/Wild_Animal_Sports_Day

[list]
[*] [b]The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe [/b](a spinoff for Ginger in this spin-off game)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033220/The_Amazing_Shrinking_Giraffe/

And coming soon (6 Jan 2023)....
[list]
[*] [b]Puzzling Wild IQ Test[/b] - (a different kind of game to test how big your brain is)
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078070/Puzzling_Wild_IQ_Test/


Or if you like text adventures (which is not part of the Wild Animal series) there is also:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781920/The_Haunted_House_of_Doom/


Hope you all have a fantastic new year and wishing you all have an interesting and exciting 2023.

As for me my new year's resolution is to finish painting my room and make more games. Shouldn't be too difficult. What's yours?

Paul.

notes.title: A Wild Halloween game...???!!
notes.content:
From the creator of Wild Animal Sports Day, a new 2D command driven adventure game. You have to go round the different rooms and collect the items to solve the mystery. But beware... some surprises await! If you are easily scared, maybe best to avoid this one!

If not, have a go. Do you have a sporting chance of solving the mystery of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16786/Wild_Animal_Sports_Day__Haunted_House_of_Doom_Halloween_Bundle/]The Haunted House of Doom?[/url]

Or if you own one of these games you can get the other in the bundle deal to get a discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16786/Wild_Animal_Sports_Day__Haunted_House_of_Doom_Halloween_Bundle/

notes.title: Haunted House of Doom!
notes.content:
Paul Bird has released a new game called "[b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b]" just in time for Halloween!

The game is a puzzle game where you have to collect objects to solve the puzzles in the house and solve the mystery of [b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b].

Solve the mystery at your own pace. But, there is a horror theme so, the game has a bit of a bite!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781920/The_Haunted_House_of_Doom/

The game is having positive reviews so far. If you like this sort of game, why not give it a go?

If you like old style adventure games this game might be for you.

notes.title: Release day!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Today is the release day of Wild Animal Sports Day! I hope you enjoy it. I've no idea if people will like this game so it will be interesting to find out in the next week or so.

Special thanks to the volunteer beta testers:

Bon Sufar
I eat hackers for breakfast
Nazhyco (for Japanese translation)
Truenoo
SyStematicalAB1

and anyone else who gave feedback.

So all I can say, is. Hope you enjoy! And kick that King Croc's ass!

notes.title: Developer Log
notes.content:
Currently working on more animations and trying to make each of the 8 tasks unique and compelling. 

It's all heading the right direction. 

Stay tuned.

notes.title: Sorry for delay....
notes.content:
Hello,

Well, yes, because of things like moving house and stuff this game is going to be a bit later than I anticipated. (How typical. Amirite?)

But just to let you know I am working on it. (For example today I was working on the porcupines. Yes, there are porcupines in this game.) 

I'm not going to put a definite release date because obviously I'm bad at judging these things! But definitely it will be out this summer but I won't release it until I'm 100% happy with it.

Most of it is there, it just needs that little bit extra to make it a really fun game. They say the last 1% always takes the longest time.

Anyway, thanks for your patience!

Paul.

notes.title: Wild Animal Sports Day - coming this summer! (Or before)
notes.content:
Hello, so this is just to tell you about Wild Animal Sports Day. It is a sequel or perhaps I should say "spin-off" to Wild Animal Racing. It has the same characters but is a different kind of game. In this game you have to become a master at 8 sporting tasks much  like the Labours of Hercules. If you can master these tasks you will become king of Wild Animal Island.

The videos are beta game footage and they'll be updated as the launch date nears. But feel free to add comments or suggestions. You never know if you have a great suggestion it might find its way into the game!
